answer.reason: Several verses tell what was done to Millo: it was built by Solomon and later repaired when the city's defences were strengthened.

clauses.english: was built by Solomon, along with the wall of Jerusalem
was repaired when the broken wall of the city was built up
clauses.quote: repaired Millo in the city of David

doubts: The given verses do not name the one who repaired Millo in 2CH 32:5, so the clause leaves him unnamed.
2SA 5:9 and 1CH 11:8 only mark Millo as a point from which David built, so they are not used.
